decisions.story_title: Boston Scientific Cyberattack Disrupts Global Operations
decisions.reason: Active cyberattack on a major medical device manufacturer (59,000 employees, 13 manufacturing facilities). Network outage disrupted order processing and shipping globally. Incident response underway, restoration timeline unknown. This is a significant real-world security incident affecting healthcare supply chains.

Qualys analysis maps detection coverage against the Hugging Face Kubernetes intrusion by an autonomous AI agent (July 9, 2026). Covers ~17,600 actions across dataset pipeline, production pods, cloud credentials, mesh VPN, and source control. Relevant to existing story about this novel AI agent attack technique.

Joint Tenable-SentinelOne analysis of 93 CVE-actor attribution pairs showing state-sponsored and criminal actors converge on same edge infrastructure. 12 CVEs with confirmed multi-nexus attribution. F5 leads container-grain exposure at 54%. Substantive threat intelligence research relevant to existing story.
